name: forensic-software-auditor
description: Evidence-led software repository auditing with read-only inventory, traceable file coverage, verified findings, risk prioritization, and remediation planning.

interface.longDescription: A structured, evidence-led workflow for reviewing software repositories. Build a read-only file inventory, track inspected and unreviewed files, assess code quality, security, architecture, performance, testing, dependencies, configuration, deployment, data integrity, accessibility, UX, and documentation. Distinguish confirmed findings from hypotheses, document limitations, and prepare prioritized remediation plans and GitHub issue proposals. The initial audit phase does not modify the target project or execute its code. Project website: https://kathennn.github.io/forensic-software-auditor/
defaultPrompt: Start a forensic, evidence-led audit of my repository. Begin with Phase 1: inventory only, and do not modify anything.
Continue the repository audit from its recorded coverage and inspect the next controlled block of files.
Prepare a prioritized remediation plan and GitHub issue proposals from verified audit findings. Do not create issues or modify code.
